gloss: preview screening; advance showing (of a film)

definitions.gloss: preview screening; advance showing; press screening
definitions.explanation: A screening of a film held before its official release, typically for critics, media, and invited guests. Also includes public preview events held as promotional activities.

examples.japanese: {試写会|ししゃかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{招待|しょうたい}→招待：01435_shoutai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was invited to a preview screening.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新作|しんさく}{映画|えいが}→新作映画：25174_shinsakueiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{試写会|ししゃかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I won tickets to the preview screening of the new movie.

examples.japanese: {試写会|ししゃかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{主演|しゅえん}→主演：08254_shuen⟧⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{舞台挨拶|ぶたいあいさつ}→舞台挨拶：22303_butaiaisatsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}いに→大いに：01609_ooini⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がった→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧。
examples.english: The preview screening also featured a stage greeting from the lead actor, and the venue was very lively.

notes:
A common term in the Japanese entertainment industry. Preview screenings serve both as promotional events and as a way for critics to review films before release.

FORMS:
{試写|ししゃ} (test screening) + ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (event, gathering)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {試写会|ししゃかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{招待|しょうたい}する→招待する：01833_shoutaisuru⟧: to invite to a preview screening
- {試写会|ししゃかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to win a spot at a preview screening
- {試写会|ししゃかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to apply for a preview screening
- ⟦マスコミ→マスコミ：03872_masukomi⟧{試写|ししゃ}: press screening
- ⟦{完成|かんせい}→完成：01550_kansei⟧{試写会|ししゃかい}: completion preview (screening of the finished film)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, many preview screenings are open to the general public through lotteries or magazine/website promotions. Winning (⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧) a spot is a popular way to see anticipated films early. These events often include ⟦{舞台挨拶|ぶたいあいさつ}→舞台挨拶：22303_butaiaisatsu⟧ (stage greetings) by the cast.
